# Person DPoP prototype vectors

`person-dpop.json` is generated by `node verification/fixtures/generate-person-dpop.ts`
from the repository root after the frozen verification dependencies are installed.
JOSE is pinned to 6.2.12. Test key seeds and clocks are fixed and synthetic. ECDSA
signatures are randomized when regenerating; tests consume the committed bytes.

The real native and Worker crypto adapters consume exactly the same vectors.
Each negative specifies its exact refusal reason to prevent setup failures from
masquerading as proof. Successful fixtures carry independent JOSE thumbprint and
Node SHA-256 canonical intent values.

Intent is a prototype-only UTF-8 JSON tuple:
`["fleet-person-intent-prototype-v1", organization_id, person_id, operation_id,
"renameWorkspace", workspace_id, display_name]`.
It excludes request IDs, token bytes and proof bytes; a fresh proof can retain
the same stable operation intent. Body keys/order/whitespace do not affect it.
The closed operation parser rejects unknown body fields.

These vectors do not define the future Fleet public wire or prove issuer
snapshot coherence, key rotation/fetch, floors, permissions, factor freshness,
used-request persistence or first-use replay admission.
